Evan P.: quick brainstorm: run a micro-experiment on /pricing that combines a compact estimator, a 3-line FAQ top fold, and a webinar CTA. keep it lightweight. Nina M.: what counts as success? trial starts or demo requests? Evan P.: primary = trial starts (7-day conversion). secondary = demo/webinar RSVPs. also watch bounce rate and estimator engagement. Carlos J.: two treatment ideas: T1: inline compact estimator showing monthly + yearly with a small savings chip. T2: same estimator but with an explicit committed-plan CTA ("See committed pricing"). split test. Tess R.: routing rule: if estimator output >= $4000/month tag lead as "pv_highvalue" and forward to sales-triage webhook. keep tag in payload for funnel analysis. Nina M.: FAQ trim suggestion: collapse long entries into 3 lines: 1) billing & tokens, 2) models & latency, 3) commitments & discounts. each line gets a "learn more" link. aim to reduce visible accordion items by 40%. Evan P.: good. also consider a small savings tooltip for yearly pricing to highlight economics without cluttering the page. Carlos J.: engineering constraints: lazy-load calculator after LCP; budget <60ms main-thread delta. also make estimator call idempotent and cacheable for repeat interactions. Tess R.: sample router config for eng: {"threshold_usd_per_month":"4000","tag":"pv_highvalue","webhook":"/hooks/sales-triage"}. will share as gist. Nina M.: microcopy variants for estimator label: A) "Estimated monthly cost" B) "Typical monthly spend (estimate)" C) "Starting monthly cost \u2014 refine with your settings". prefer C to set expectation and invite interaction. Evan P.: pick C vs A. lean C. Carlos J.: tracking checklist: estimator_impression, estimator_interaction, estimator_submit, estimator_cta_click, lead_tag_applied. map to GA + internal experiment events. Tess R.: experiment length proposal: run 14 days or until 1.2k estimator uses. pre-register dashboards: conversion by estimate band, lead tags count, trial-start UAC. marketing-bot: staging snippet created:
Evan P.: I'll draft the experiment doc and share runbook. Nina will own analysis. Carlos please coordinate with eng-runtime about lazy-load and caching. Nina M.: will own analysis; will add success thresholds (+6% trial starts or +10% webinar CTR) and report cadence (mid-run check at day 7). Tess R.: will post trimmed FAQ copy to #docs for review in 18h. Evan P.: thanks team. will upload A/B variants and tag growth & eng-runtime for visibility. :rocket:
